name: InterpolateXYTable
formula: =LAMBDA(x_value,x,y,LET(author, "Kinen Ma", version_date, "v3, 2023-09-21", n, ROWS(x), is_asc, INDEX(x, 1, 1) < INDEX(x, n, 1), search_type, IF(is_asc, 1, -1), idx_ori, XMATCH(x_value, x, -1, search_type), idx, IFERROR(IF(INDEX(x, idx_ori, 1) = INDEX(x, idx_ori + 1, 1), idx_ori + 1, idx_ori), idx_ori), calc_smaller, LAMBDA(LET(x_1, INDEX(x, 1, 1), x_2, INDEX(x, 2, 1), y_1, INDEX(y, 1, 1), y_2, INDEX(y, 2, 1), y_1 + (x_value - x_1) * (y_2 - y_1) / (x_2 - x_1))), calc_larger, LAMBDA(LET(x_1, INDEX(x, n - 1, 1), x_2, INDEX(x, n, 1), y_1, INDEX(y, n - 1, 1), y_2, INDEX(y, n, 1), y_1 + (x_value - x_1) * (y_2 - y_1) / (x_2 - x_1))), calc_within, LAMBDA(LET(x_floor, INDEX(x, idx, 1), y_floor, INDEX(y, idx, 1), IF(x_value = x_floor, y_floor, LET(y_ceil, INDEX(y, idx + 1, 1), x_ceil, INDEX(x, idx + 1, 1), y_floor + (x_value - x_floor) * (y_ceil - y_floor) / (x_ceil - x_floor))))), chosen_thunk, IF(ISNA(idx), calc_smaller, IF(idx = n, calc_larger, calc_within)), output, chosen_thunk(), output))
comment: Interpolate x value within x array and corresponding y array (i.e. lookup + interpolate). The array must be already sorted in accending or decending order. INTERPOLATE(float, array[float], array[float])
